description: Complete rewrite of preset-handler.js to fix the broken preset switching system, and audit all widget control IDs against preset data keys to fix mismatches.
steps: Rewrite vira-sections-plugin/assets/js/preset-handler.js completely with these fixes: (1) Remove the viraPresetBound flag entirely - use a fresh event binding approach that works when the same panel is reopened for different widget instances. (2) Use Elementor's official $e.run('document/elements/settings', { container: view.getContainer(), settings: data }) command to apply all settings atomically. (3) After applying, force the panel to re-render controls so the visual state matches. (4) Add a fallback for older Elementor versions that uses model.setSetting(). (5) The change event listener should properly detect the vira_preset SELECT element even when nested inside Elementor wrapper elements - do not rely solely on e.target.dataset.setting.

Audit every widget's register_controls() method in all 12 widget files under vira-sections-plugin/widgets/ and compare each control ID with the corresponding keys used in the preset data arrays in class-presets.php. Document and fix any mismatches found. Key widgets to check: class-hero.php (controls: badge_icon, badge_text, heading_before, rotating_words, description, btn_primary_text, btn_secondary_text, stats, marquee_items, aurora_color_1, aurora_color_2, btn_grad_from, btn_grad_to, rotating_grad_from, rotating_grad_to, bg_color), class-services-bento.php (controls: eyebrow, heading, description, cards), class-pricing.php (controls: eyebrow, heading, description, show_toggle, plans, bottom_note), class-testimonials-slider.php (controls: eyebrow, heading, description, items), class-faq-search.php (controls: eyebrow, heading, categories, items), class-cta-form.php (controls: badge_text, heading, description, features, select_options, submit_text + palette colors), class-process-timeline.php (controls: eyebrow, heading, description, steps), class-tabs.php (controls: eyebrow, heading, description, tabs), class-tech-stack.php (controls: eyebrow, heading, description, tabs, logos), class-stats-counter.php (controls: eyebrow, heading, description, counters), class-trust-strip.php (controls: mode, eyebrow, heading, logos, logos_title), class-curriculum.php (controls: eyebrow, heading, description, totals_modules, totals_hours, modules).

For any mismatch found: if the widget control ID differs from the preset data key, update the preset data key in class-presets.php to match the widget control ID (since the widget is the source of truth for Elementor).
acceptance_criteria: preset-handler.js uses $e.run('document/elements/settings') for atomic settings application
No viraPresetBound flag exists in the code
Panel re-renders after preset application so controls show updated values
Event listener correctly detects preset dropdown changes regardless of DOM nesting
All preset data keys in class-presets.php exactly match their corresponding widget control IDs
php -l passes on all modified PHP files
verification: Verify preset-handler.js does not contain 'viraPresetBound' string
Verify preset-handler.js contains '$e.run' for settings application
findings: All 12 widget control IDs exactly match their preset data keys in class-presets.php - no mismatches found. PHP and Node are not available in this sandbox environment so php -l could not run, but no PHP files were modified. The JS rewrite follows the exact spec from the feature requirements.
